PLAN "1-Week Deload (Phase: Deload)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "deload week with reduced volume and intensity"

PHASES
  PHASE "Deload Phase" (1 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Deload Session 1":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 2x6 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          pull_up 2x3 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bench_press 2x5 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Tuesday training 40m "Deload Session 2":
        warmup:
          jogging 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 2x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 2x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          lats_stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Deload Session 3":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          shoulder_press 2x5 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_fly 2x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 2x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Thursday training 40m "Deload Session 4":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 2x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 2x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 2x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 40m "Deload Session 5":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bicep_curl 2x6 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x6 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          plank 2x30 seconds rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          core_stretch 5 minutes

Note: If needed, you can swap any day for rest or adjust to 4 sessions to accommodate gym scheduling, keeping loads and reps reduced as shown.

PLAN "Deload Strength Marker Testing"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "strength marker testing during deload without heavy fatigue"

PHASES
  PHASE "Testing Phase within Deload" (1 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 15m "Marker Test Day 1 - Upper Push":
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 1x5 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
        notes:
          Use standardized rep test; no to light effort to avoid fatigue
      DAY Tuesday training 15m "Marker Test Day 2 - Upper Pull/Back":
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 1x3 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
        notes:
          If unable, substitute with dumbbell_row 1x5 rpe 5
      DAY Wednesday training 15m "Marker Test Day 3 - Press Strength":
        main straight_sets:
          shoulder_press 1x5 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
        notes:
          Alternative: incline_press 1x5 rpe 5
      DAY Thursday training 15m "Marker Test Day 4 - Lower Body (low fatigue)":
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 1x5 rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
        notes:
          If needed, substitute leg_press 1x5 rpe 5
      DAY Friday training 15m "Marker Test Day 5 - Core/anti-fatigue markers":
        main straight_sets:
          plank 3x30 seconds rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
        notes:
          - Optional hollow_hold 3x20 seconds if needed

Notes:
- Keep tests very light and prescriptive to minimize fatigue.
- Do not exceed one set per movement; avoid high RPE blocks.
- Track: reps completed at target reps, RPE, and any technique notes.
- Aggregate into a quick weekly log to monitor trends without impacting deload integrity.

            leg_press 2x6

            hip_thrust 2x6
          mobility: yes

      DAY Friday training 0m "Deload Session 5 - Subbed + Mobility + Zone2 (intensified)":
